The app is ready as a polished, local-first MVP at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).

### What works

- Paste a public URL and automatically retrieve its title, description, canonical URL, preview image, and available keywords.
- Save links even when metadata retrieval is blocked.
- Edit or delete existing bookmarks.
- Favorite links and manage the read-later state.
- Search titles, domains, notes, and tags. `Ctrl/⌘ + K` focuses search.
- Filter by favorites, unread links, or collection.
- Create persistent custom collections.
- Switch between grid and list layouts.
- Sort by recency, title, or favorites.
- Export the complete library as `stash-bookmarks.json`.
- Retain bookmarks and collections between visits using browser storage.
- Use the principal flows on desktop or mobile.

### Validation completed

I exercised live MDN metadata retrieval and saving, favorites, collection creation, exact search, keyboard navigation, list view, JSON export, and the mobile add dialog. The production build passes with no browser-console errors.

### Current boundary

This version stores everything in the current browser. It does not yet include accounts, cloud synchronization, sharing, browser extensions, or cross-device access. Public-page metadata also requires an internet connection, with the manual-save fallback covering blocked pages.
